name: 2 Day Kawah Ijen Expedition from Surabaya

itineraryDays.title: Surabaya to Bondowoso for Ijen Staging
itineraryDays.summary: The first day is a dedicated transfer from Surabaya to the Bondowoso side so the route can stage properly for Ijen. After hotel check-in, the required health screening is completed before the climb window begins.

activities.name: Surabaya to Bondowoso Transfer
activities.description: Pickup by our team at your location in Surabaya. After meeting at the confirmed pick-up point, begin the overland transfer toward Bondowoso (Ijen area) as scheduled in the route plan.

activities.name: Lunch at Local Restaurant
activities.description: Stop at a local restaurant for lunch (cost not included). This is the planned meal break during the transfer, allowing time to order food and rest briefly before continuing to Bondowoso.

activities.name: Local Restaurant to Bondowoso Transfer
activities.description: Continue the overland journey from the restaurant toward Bondowoso, arriving in time for hotel check-in.

activities.name: Check-in Bondowoso Hotel
activities.description: Arrive in Bondowoso and complete the hotel check-in process. This step covers arrival at the accommodation and the basic check-in procedure so you can settle in after the transfer.

activities.name: Ijen health screening
activities.description: A health screening will be conducted by medical personnel directly at your hotel. This is a scheduled screening session as listed in the itinerary to complete the required check before the Ijen-area program.

activities.name: Dinner at Accommodation
activities.description: Dinner is served at the accommodation or a nearby restaurant (included). This is the planned dinner time after the transfer and screening, scheduled as an included meal for the day.

itineraryDays.title: Ijen Climb and Return to Surabaya
itineraryDays.summary: After the Ijen segment is completed, the route returns across East Java to Surabaya. This final day works best when guests treat the return as part of a serious two-day Ijen sequence, not as an afterthought.

activities.name: Short break after the hike
activities.description: Short break after Ijen Hike. Take a short recovery break in the Ijen area after the hike, allowing time to rest briefly and prepare for the return logistics.

activities.name: Check-out and Transfer to Surabaya
activities.description: Return to the hotel in Bondowoso. Depart from the Ijen area and proceed with the transfer back to the Bondowoso hotel, closing the Ijen-area segment for the day.

activities.name: Having lunch at the hotel
activities.description: Having lunch at the hotel. Use this planned meal break at the hotel restaurant as scheduled, allowing time to sit down and eat before continuing the remaining transfer segment.

activities.name: Bondowoso to Surabaya Transfer
activities.description: Start the journey to Surabaya. Depart from the Bondowoso hotel and continue the long overland transfer toward Surabaya as scheduled.

activities.name: Arrival and Transfer in Surabaya
activities.description: Arrive in Surabaya, transfer to hotel/airport. Tour ends. Reach Surabaya and complete the final transfer to the requested drop-off point (hotel/airport), concluding services after drop-off.
